## Welcome to Hiddify Manager Hiddify Manager is a free and open-source anti-censorship panel that you install on your own server. It runs a multi-user VPN and proxy server with **more than 20 protocols**, including **Reality** and a **Telegram proxy**, and gives you a modern web panel to manage your users, domains and settings. It is tuned for heavy filtering in **Iran, China and Russia**, and is listed by [Xray](https://github.com/XTLS/Xray-core#installation).
### Table of contents - [Quick install](#quick-install) - [Why Hiddify Manager?](#why-hiddify-manager) - [Main features](#main-features) - [Supported protocols](#supported-protocols) - [Installation and tutorials](#installation-and-tutorials) - [Acknowledgements](#acknowledgements) - [Donation and support](#donation-and-support) - [Collaboration and contact](#collaboration-and-contact) ## Quick install You need a server (VPS) with **Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04 or 26.04** (amd64 or arm64), at least **1 GB RAM, 1 CPU core and 10 GB of storage**. Connect to the server over SSH and run: ```bash bash <(curl https://i.hiddify.com/release) ``` At the end, the installer shows your admin link. Open it, follow the quick setup, and add your first user. The [installation guide](https://hiddify.com/manager/installation-and-setup/guide/) explains every step; there are also one-click guides for [Hetzner](https://hiddify.com/manager/installation-and-setup/Quick-installation-on-Hetzner-Servers/), [Oracle Cloud](https://hiddify.com/manager/installation-and-setup/Quick-Installation-on-Oracle-Cloud/), [Azure](https://hiddify.com/manager/installation-and-setup/Quick-Installation-on-Microsoft-Azure/) and [cloud-init](https://hiddify.com/manager/installation-and-setup/Cloud-init-installation/). To connect from phones and computers, we recommend the [Hiddify app](https://github.com/hiddify/hiddify-app). ## Why Hiddify Manager? The name *Hiddify* comes from **hidden** and **simplify**: the goal is a server that is hard to detect and easy to run. ### Main features - 🖥 **Modern admin panel (Admin V2)** in 28 languages, with light and dark themes, that also works on phones. - ⚡ **Quick installation** and a guided first setup; **automatic updates** and **automatic backups** (also sent to you on Telegram). - 🧠 **Xray and sing-box cores** together, with **smart routing** that keeps domestic sites off the proxy. - 🌐 **Every kind of domain:** direct, CDN (Cloudflare and others), relay, subscription-only, Reality, fake and wildcard domains; automatic certificates. - 👥 **User management:** data and time limits per user, renewals, tags, and **three admin roles** (super admin, admin, agent) with per-admin limits. - 📱 **Personal user page** for each user: usage, configs, QR codes, and one-tap import into the Hiddify app and other clients. - 🤖 **Telegram bot** for you and your users: create and manage users, server status, free test accounts, reminders and support messages. - ✈️ **Telegram proxy** (MTProxy FakeTLS) and a **Telegram web proxy through Cloudflare**. - 🛰 **Multi-server:** connect several servers (nodes) to one parent panel. - 🧰 **Tools:** config tester, clean IP scanner, Reality domain scanner, WARP, firewall, DNS over HTTPS, custom outbounds and config templates. ### Supported protocols **VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Reality, Shadowsocks (2022, ShadowTLS), Hysteria2, TUIC, WireGuard, AnyTLS, Snell, Naive, Mieru, SSH, xHTTP, gRPC, WebSocket, HTTPUpgrade,** DNS tunnels (**VayDNS, Slipstream, MasterDnsVPN**) and the **Telegram proxy**, over direct, CDN and relay domains. ## Installation and tutorials All tutorials, with pictures and videos, are on our website: - [Installation guide](https://hiddify.com/manager/installation-and-setup/guide/) - [How to configure the panel properly](https://hiddify.com/manager/configuration-and-advanced-settings/How-to-configure-Hiddify-panel-properly/) - [Domains, CDN and Cloudflare](https://hiddify.com/manager/domain-worker-cdn-and-tunneling/How-to-use-Cloudflare-CDN/) - [All Hiddify Manager tutorials and videos](https://hiddify.com/manager/)
## Acknowledgements We sincerely thank the contributors of these projects; their solid foundation and features made this project possible: - [sing-box](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box) - [Xray](https://github.com/XTLS/Xray-core) - [Linux by Linus Torvalds](https://github.com/torvalds/linux) - Font: [Vazirmatn by Saber Rastikerdar](https://github.com/rastikerdar/vazirmatn) ## Donation and support The easiest way to support us is to give this repository a star (⭐) at the top of this page.
We also need financial support for our services. All our work is voluntary, and every donation goes to the development of the project. See our [donation page](https://hiddify.com/donation-and-support/). ## Collaboration and contact Hiddify is a community-driven project, and we need your help. If you are skilled in any of these areas, please contact us and mention your skill: - Python development - Vue / TypeScript development - Go development - Media production
